en.headline: New Lantao Bus collides with trees at Shenzhen Bay Port; no injuries
en.dek: A double-decker Volvo B8L left the roadway after dropping passengers on Sunday morning, damaging two trees and its upper windscreen; the driver was assisting police.
body: A New Lantao Bus double-decker collided with trees at Shenzhen Bay Port on Sunday morning, causing no injuries.

Police said the incident occurred around 11 am after the Volvo B8L had dropped passengers. The bus left the roadway, mounted a central planter, struck and felled one tree, tilted another and shattered its upper windscreen. A planter water tank was also displaced.
The 51-year-old female driver was assisting investigations. Officers said the cause remained under inquiry and that the driver had steered onto the planter to avoid other buses.

zh.headline: 深圳灣口岸新大嶼山巴士自炒撞樹 無人受傷
zh.dek: 周日上午約11時一輛Volvo B8L雙層巴士落客後失控，剷上路中花槽撞毀兩棵樹及上層擋風玻璃，車長協助調查。
body: 一輛新大嶼山巴士周日上午在深圳灣口岸發生自炒意外，撞毀樹木及上層擋風玻璃，無人受傷。
事發約上午11時，該輛Volvo B8L落客後失控，剷上路中花槽石壆，撞塌一棵樹、壓斜另一棵，上層擋風玻璃爆裂，花槽水箱亦被撞歪。
51歲姓李女車長在場協助警方調查。據悉車長為免波及其他巴士而剷上石壆。警方正調查意外原因。
